name: TabbedContainer

legacy.name: Tabs.examples.md
legacy.markdown:
```jsx
<Tabs initialTab="Hello">
  <Tab title="Hello">Hello World</Tab>
  <Tab title="Goodbye">Goodbye</Tab>
  <Tab title="Complex">
    <Grid.Row cards deck>
      <Grid.Col md={4}>
        <Card body="Short content" />
      </Grid.Col>
      <Grid.Col md={4}>
        <Card
          body="Extra long content of card. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consetetur sadipscing elitr"
        />
      </Grid.Col>
      <Grid.Col md={4}>
        <Card body="Short content" />
      </Grid.Col>
    </Grid.Row>
  </Tab>
</Tabs>
```

guide.summary: Contenedor de paneles cuyo título coincide con una selección.
